examples: The young prince was the sole heir to the throne after his father's death.
شاهزاده جوان تنها وارث تخت پس از مرگ پدرش بود.
As the only heir, she inherited the family's old farmhouse and all its land.
او به‌عنوان تنها وارث، خانه قدیمی خانوادگی و تمام زمین‌هایش را به ارث برد.
Being named heir to a fortune does not guarantee a person will manage it wisely.
وارث یک ثروت بودن تضمین نمی‌کند که فرد آن را عاقلانه مدیریت کند.
miniContext: In many old stories, the heir to a kingdom must prove his worth before taking the throne. When a wealthy person dies without naming an heir, courts often have to decide who inherits the property. Families sometimes argue for years over who the rightful heir should be, especially when a will is unclear.

examples: Our supplies will dwindle quickly if we don't ration the food carefully.
اگر غذا را با احتیاط جیره‌بندی نکنیم، ذخایرمان خیلی زود کم و کمتر خواهد شد.
The number of volunteers began to dwindle as the harsh winter continued.
با ادامه یافتن زمستان سخت، تعداد داوطلبان رو به کاهش گذاشت.
Her enthusiasm for the project dwindled after months of slow progress.
شور و اشتیاق او برای این پروژه بعد از ماه‌ها پیشرفت کند، کم‌رنگ شد.
miniContext: Fish populations in the lake began to dwindle after the factory started dumping waste nearby. Local fishermen noticed their daily catch shrinking year after year. Scientists warned that if nothing changed, the species would dwindle to the point of disappearing from the lake entirely.

examples: The company's decision to delay the announcement was deliberate, not accidental.
تصمیم شرکت برای تاخیر در اعلامیه عمدی بود، نه تصادفی.
She spoke in a slow, deliberate voice so everyone could understand her instructions.
او با صدایی آهسته و سنجیده صحبت کرد تا همه بتوانند دستورالعمل‌هایش را بفهمند.
Investigators concluded that the fire was deliberate rather than an accident caused by faulty wiring.
بازپرسان نتیجه‌گیری کردند که آتش‌سوزی عمدی بود، نه تصادفی ناشی از سیم‌کشی معیوب.
miniContext: A deliberate choice is one made on purpose, after careful thought, rather than by chance. Judges often consider whether a crime was deliberate or accidental when deciding on a sentence. Moving at a deliberate pace, the climbers tested each foothold before trusting it with their weight.

examples: The farm produced a surplus of wheat this year, more than the region could use.
مزرعه امسال مازادی از گندم تولید کرد، بیشتر از آنچه منطقه می‌توانست استفاده کند.
The government used the budget surplus to pay down part of the national debt.
دولت از مازاد بودجه برای بازپرداخت بخشی از بدهی ملی استفاده کرد.
After the harvest, the surplus vegetables were donated to a local food bank.
بعد از برداشت محصول، سبزیجات مازاد به یک بانک غذایی محلی اهدا شد.
miniContext: A surplus occurs whenever supply exceeds what is actually needed or demanded. Companies sometimes struggle to store a large surplus of unsold goods during a slow season. Economists watch the trade surplus closely because it reveals whether a country exports more than it imports.

examples: You should heed your doctor's advice and rest until the fever is gone.
باید به توصیه پزشکت توجه کنی و تا رفع تب استراحت کنی.
The sailors failed to heed the storm warning and sailed straight into the rough seas.
ملوانان به هشدار طوفان توجه نکردند و مستقیم به دریای متلاطم رفتند.
Few teenagers heed their parents' warnings about the dangers of reckless driving.
تعداد کمی از نوجوانان به هشدارهای والدینشان درباره خطرات رانندگی بی‌احتیاط توجه می‌کنند.
miniContext: To heed something means to pay close attention to it and act accordingly, rather than ignoring it. Wise travelers heed local warnings about weather and wildlife before setting out on a trail. When a company ignores customer complaints instead of heeding them, it often loses business over time.

examples: The new leader hoped to unify the divided political parties around a single goal.
رهبر جدید امید داشت حزب‌های سیاسی پراکنده را حول یک هدف واحد یکپارچه کند.
A shared language can unify people from very different cultural backgrounds.
یک زبان مشترک می‌تواند مردمی با پیشینه‌های فرهنگی بسیار متفاوت را یکپارچه کند.
The company redesigned its products to unify the brand's look across every market.
شرکت محصولاتش را بازطراحی کرد تا ظاهر برند را در هر بازار یکپارچه کند.
miniContext: To unify means to bring separate parts together into a single, coordinated whole. After the war, leaders worked for years to unify the fractured regions under one government. A good team captain can unify players with different personalities around a common strategy.

examples: A vandal spray-painted the school walls overnight, and the principal called the police.
یک خرابکار شب گذشته دیوارهای مدرسه را با اسپری رنگ کرد و مدیر پلیس را خبر کرد.
Someone acting like a vandal smashed the windows of three parked cars on our street.
کسی که مثل یک خرابکار رفتار می‌کرد شیشه‌های سه خودروی پارک‌شده در خیابان ما را شکست.
The museum installed cameras after a vandal damaged one of the ancient statues.
موزه بعد از آنکه یک خرابکار یکی از مجسمه‌های باستانی را آسیب زد، دوربین نصب کرد.
miniContext: A vandal is someone who deliberately destroys or damages property that does not belong to them. City officials complained that a single vandal could undo months of work restoring the old fountain. Communities often install better lighting in parks to discourage vandals from damaging benches and signs at night.

examples: All members must abide by the club's rules if they want to keep their membership.
همه اعضا باید به قوانین کلوپ پایبند باشند اگر می‌خواهند عضویتشان را حفظ کنند.
I simply cannot abide people who talk loudly during a movie.
من واقعاً نمی‌توانم افرادی را که در حین فیلم بلند صحبت می‌کنند تحمل کنم.
Drivers are expected to abide by traffic signals even late at night when roads are empty.
از رانندگان انتظار می‌رود حتی نیمه‌شب که خیابان‌ها خالی هستند، از علائم راهنمایی پیروی کنند.
miniContext: To abide by a rule means to accept it and act according to it, while to abide something else can mean to tolerate it. Citizens are required to abide by the laws of the country they live in. Some people say they cannot abide dishonesty, no matter how small the lie seems.

examples: The region suffered its worst drought in fifty years, leaving the reservoirs almost empty.
این منطقه بدترین خشکسالی پنجاه سال گذشته را تجربه کرد و مخازن آب تقریباً خالی شدند.
Farmers lost most of their crops during the long summer drought.
کشاورزان بیشتر محصولاتشان را در طول خشکسالی طولانی تابستان از دست دادند.
City officials asked residents to conserve water because of the ongoing drought.
مقامات شهری از ساکنان خواستند به‌دلیل خشکسالی ادامه‌دار در مصرف آب صرفه‌جویی کنند.
miniContext: A drought is a long period of unusually low rainfall that leaves land and rivers dry. During a severe drought, wells can run dry and wildfires become far more likely. Governments sometimes declare a state of emergency when a drought threatens the food supply.

examples: The climbers finally reached the summit after eight exhausting hours of climbing.
کوهنوردان سرانجام بعد از هشت ساعت صعود خسته‌کننده به قله رسیدند.
World leaders gathered at the summit to discuss climate change policies.
رهبران جهان در این نشست عالی گرد هم آمدند تا درباره سیاست‌های تغییرات آب‌وهوایی گفتگو کنند.
From the summit, you can see three different valleys stretching below.
از قله می‌توانید سه دره مختلف را که در پایین کشیده شده‌اند، ببینید.
miniContext: A summit can refer to the highest point of a mountain or to an important meeting between top leaders. Many hikers train for months before attempting to reach a difficult summit. The two presidents held a summit to try to resolve years of tension between their countries.

examples: History remembers him as a traitor who sold military secrets to the enemy.
تاریخ او را به‌عنوان خائنی به خاطر می‌آورد که اسرار نظامی را به دشمن فروخت.
The soldiers accused their former commander of being a traitor to the country.
سربازان فرمانده سابق خود را به خیانت به کشور متهم کردند.
In the novel, the king's own brother turns out to be the traitor.
در این رمان، برادر خود پادشاه خائن از آب درمی‌آید.
miniContext: A traitor is someone who betrays their country, group, or friends, often by helping an enemy. During the war, anyone suspected of being a traitor faced severe punishment. The story's twist reveals that the trusted advisor was a traitor all along, secretly working for the invading army.

examples: The mountains looked majestic against the orange sky at sunset.
کوه‌ها در برابر آسمان نارنجی هنگام غروب باشکوه به نظر می‌رسیدند.
Tourists stood in silence, staring up at the majestic waterfall.
گردشگران در سکوت ایستادند و به آبشار باشکوه نگاه کردند.
The old castle, though partly ruined, still has a majestic presence on the hilltop.
قلعه قدیمی، با وجود اینکه تا حدی ویران شده، همچنان حضوری باشکوه بر فراز تپه دارد.
miniContext: Majestic describes something so grand, beautiful, or impressive that it inspires awe. Eagles soaring over the canyon are often described as majestic because of their size and grace. Visitors from around the world travel to see the majestic cathedrals built centuries ago.
